name: MV Electrosystems Ltd
tagline: Fresh-IPO railway-propulsion play: currently loss-making with declining revenue, but a ~19x-revenue Indian Railways order book is a specific, large catalyst — speculative 10x frame, Low conviction
business_overview: MV Electrosystems designs and manufactures electrical and power-electronics equipment for railway rolling stock — IGBT-based 3-phase propulsion systems for electric locomotives, switchgear panels, vehicle control systems and cable-protection products. IPO opened 30 July 2026, listed 6 August 2026 (~Rs 290 Cr issue). No ValuePickr thread yet; web/news + old-project baseline only.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 49 Cr (down from ~Rs 65 Cr FY25) / net loss ~Rs 12.6 Cr (vs ~+Rs 1.4 Cr FY25)
~Rs 921.6 Cr (564 propulsion systems for Indian Railways) — ~19x FY26 revenue
fundamentals_narrative: Current financials do not support investment on their own merits: revenue declined ~21% YoY in FY26, the company is loss-making, and ROE/ROCE are negative. The entire bull case is the ~Rs 921.6 Cr confirmed order book — roughly 19x FY26 revenue — for 564 IGBT propulsion systems for Indian Railways, and whether MV can convert it into revenue and profit over the coming years. Fresh IPO capital funds the ramp.
